content: APScheduler 3.x jobs are in-memory by default and lost on restart. SQLAlchemyJobStore persists job metadata (trigger, next run time) to a DB (SQLite supported) so jobs survive process restart without app-level rescheduling logic. misfire_grace_time controls whether a missed-during-downtime job still fires on restart. APScheduler 4.0 (async-first, persistent datastores) is still alpha as of mid-2026 (3.11.3 is current stable) — not production-ready.
